ctx.x: Yes. I think it was "Let Me Call You Sweetheart." That's how I first met Cozy. I went and rehearsed his band. I'd seen Jelly Roll rehearse, and I picked up on that, and I rehearsed. If I heard the arrangement today, I know it would be sad. But it was the best I could write then.
Another thing I wanted to tell you about Jelly. I knew Simeon, because Simeon...
